body.name: Quotient-enumeration handle
body.construction: Start from the acyclic removed-set representation \(\mathcal D_S\). Test whether equality of completed modified-Cholesky tuples admits a locally compositional edge coloring in a decomposable AND--OR representation; if local compositionality fails, use the lexicographically first coefficient-changing removable transition as the starting move for a reverse-search parent and derive its child oracle from reachable removed-set states.
